description:
Elena, a nursing officer, boarded a spaceship following her childhood friend, whom she had a crush on. Although Elena was the object of attention for her beautiful looks, she actually harbored a secret…     

It was that she had been recording her lewd fantasies in a diary. However, she ends up being caught by Cernil, the very friend she least wanted to be found out about.    

“Who is the person in the diary?”    

“What?”     

“I promise. That you will suffer no disadvantages whatsoever.”  

Cernil misunderstands, not realizing that the man in the diary is himself, and, consumed by jealousy, begins to lewdly interrogate Elena.  

“Don’t do this. We shouldn’t be doing this.”    

“Huh? And it’s okay with that bastard?”    

“Cernil, please…”     

“If you don’t want me to read the diary. There is also a way to do it yourself.” 

Elena, unexpectedly forced into a relationship with the person she loves, is shocked by Cernil’s sudden change in attitude, yet at the same time, she becomes aroused.    

“Snap out of it. Don’t act like this.”
    
“Why? Don’t you like me? You said you were soaking wet with pleasure when you were with that bastard.” 

The endless voyage, the night of indulgence continues.
